description: Generate a particle definition (assets/<namespace>/particles/<id>.json) and its frame sprites (assets/<namespace>/textures/particle/<prefix>_<n>.png) from a frames directory or one PNG/.mcpx frame. Frames are ordered by UTF-8 file-name bytes, never readdir order; textures[] entries are namespaced paths without .png or the textures/particle/ prefix. Every target is checked before the first write, and an occupied path refuses the whole batch unless force is true. The tool cannot add new particle types; a pack only overrides existing ones.

force.description: Replace existing output files; without it an occupied path refuses the batch.

inputPath.description: Frames directory holding .png / .mcpx frames, or one .png / .mcpx frame file. Read only.

namespace.description: Asset namespace shared by the definition and its sprites.

outputDir.description: Resource pack root; the definition lands under assets/<namespace>/particles/ and sprites under assets/<namespace>/textures/particle/.

texturePrefix.description: Sprite name prefix; defaults to the particle id.

name: particle_asset
